_doc: What each tested change is, for docs/model/feature-tests.md (python -m rentfrontier.ledger). Keys are feature sets, or '+term' for a model term. kind 'location' marks features read from where a building is; their nulls are retested first when a neighbourhood is added (Ben, 2026-10-06).

nb-bedtext-v1.about: ad states fewer or more bedrooms than the record

nb-relist-v1.about: months since the apartment's previous listing

nb-coded-v1.about: listing record's outdoor space types and extra rooms

nb-prevprice-v1.about: how the unit's previous listing was repriced

nb3-lineface-v1.about: orientation read from the apartment's line

nb3-garden-v1.about: rear windows over the open block or a wall

nb3-through-v1.about: floor-through: apartments per floor, ad says floor-through

nb3-quiet-v1.about: quiet street: busy road, narrow roadway, mid-block

nb3-loud-v1.about: a building side fronting a busy street

nb3-nearby-v1.about: walk to dog run, hospital, EMS, drop-in center, NYCHA, MSG

nb3-retail-v1.about: storefronts and food places within 150 m

nb3-lines-v1.about: each subway line group within an 8-minute walk

nb3-access-v1.about: jobs within 30 minutes by walking and subway (LODES)

nb3-bedsize-v1.about: bed size from the ad text

+dayfourier.about: Fourier season at each listing's date

+bednoise.about: a residual scale by bedroom group

+yearnoise.about: a residual scale by bedroom group and year
